compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Concise updates to existing project documentation: CLAUDE.md (architecture pointer + Always Do / Never Do additions for sprint-active marker, story-isolated branch invariant, DSO-Story trailer requirement), sprint SKILL.md (cross-refs to new Phase A draft-PR step and Phase E story-branch creation step), REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md (Strategy E region-split decision criteria and dedup rules), .claude/design-notes.md (follow-on observability ticket reference).
**Why**: Ensure future agents have accurate awareness of the new sprint behaviors and review pipeline.

**Scope**:
- IN: CLAUDE.md updates
- IN: sprint SKILL.md cross-refs
- IN: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md updates
- IN: design-notes.md / follow-on observability ticket reference
- IN: Follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md for formatting and conventions
- OUT: Creating new documentation files or patterns — Verified: per CLAUDE.md Architectural Invariant 2, feature documentation belongs in codebase-overview, not new docs

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, CLAUDE.md, sprint SKILL.md, REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, and design-notes.md are updated to reflect the new behaviors with no broken cross-references and no orphaned ticket IDs
  ← Satisfies: "Documentation update"

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md for formatting, structure, and conventions.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
